title: One Person Building a $1 Million Annual Income: AI Is Giving Rise to a Golden Age for Solo Entrepreneurs

content_html:
The Wall Street Journal reported on July 29 that in the AI era, it is no longer a fantasy for an individual to run an entire company with annual revenue exceeding $1 million, and the market is witnessing the "era of solo entrepreneurs." Stripe's estimates show that in 2023, about 4 million Americans had self-employment as their main source of income and annual sales exceeding $100,000, nearly doubling from around 2 million people in the early 2010s.

Even more impressive is the explosive growth in the high-income segment. The number of single-person businesses with annual sales over $1 million is expected to be twice that of 2023 by 2025; the number of sole proprietors with sales over $5 million and $10 million is also expected to be about three times that of 2023. Taking the 2019 figure as "1," the proportion of companies with annual sales exceeding $5 million increased from about 2.5 to about 5.3 between 2023 and 2025, while those exceeding $10 million rose from about 2.5 to about 4.8.

Industries with higher AI adoption see faster growth in startup applications

The report suggests that this growth wave is clearly related to the spread of artificial intelligence. Stripe compared AI adoption rates across industries with new business application growth rates, revealing a clear positive correlation—industries with higher AI adoption generally saw faster growth in new business applications. This means AI tools are effectively lowering the barriers to entrepreneurship, compressing tasks that once required a team into work that one person can handle.

However, there are exceptions among different industries. Manufacturing has a high AI adoption rate but saw slower growth in new business applications than expected, possibly due to the industry's reliance on heavy assets and physical supply chains. In contrast, transportation and warehousing showed higher-than-expected growth in applications, likely benefiting from the rapid implementation of AI scheduling and route optimization in logistics scenarios. When one person plus a set of AI tools can replace the output of an entire team, the definition of the word "company" may be being redefined.

content_html_zh:
《华尔街日报》7月29日报道，在人工智能时代，个人经营一家年收入超过100万美元的整个公司不再是幻想，市场正在见证“个体创业者时代”。 Stripe 的估计显示，到 2023 年，约有 400 万美国人以个体经营为主要收入来源，年销售额超过 10 万美元，比 2010 年代初的约 200 万人几乎翻了一番。

更令人印象深刻的是高收入群体的爆炸性增长。 预计到2025年，年销售额超过100万美元的单人企业数量将是2023年的两倍；销售额超过500万美元和1000万美元的个体业主数量预计也将是2023年的三倍左右。 以2019年的数字为“1”，2023年至2025年间，年销售额超过500万美元的公司比例从约2.5家增加到约5.3家，而超过1000万美元的公司比例从约2.5家增加到约4.8家。

人工智能采用率较高的行业的初创应用程序增长更快

报告表明，这一增长浪潮显然与人工智能的传播有关。 Stripe 将各行业的人工智能采用率与新业务应用程序增长率进行了比较，发现了明显的正相关关系——人工智能采用率较高的行业通常会看到新业务应用程序的更快增长。 这意味着人工智能工具正在有效降低创业门槛，将曾经需要团队完成的任务压缩为一个人就能完成的工作。

不过，不同行业之间也有例外。 制造业的人工智能采用率很高，但新业务应用的增长速度低于预期，这可能是由于该行业对重资产和实体供应链的依赖。 相比之下，运输和仓储的应用增长高于预期，可能受益于人工智能调度和路线优化在物流场景中的快速实施。 当一个人加上一套AI工具可以替代整个团队的产出时，“公司”这个词的定义可能正在被重新定义。
